name: revyl-cli
description: Run mobile changes on Revyl cloud devices and verify them with screenshots and semantic validation through the Revyl CLI.

offer_proof_after_commit.title: Offer a device check after commits
offer_proof_after_commit.description: After a commit, push, or new pull request that changes a Revyl app, the agent offers once to check it on a Revyl device. It never starts anything without your yes.
